description: Rename the Instance panel to Server in plain organizer language (ruling 2026-08-14, sequence/org-settings-design.md iteration 3; design contract prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 v1.15 #org/server). Head: 'What this Marquee is connected to, and whether each piece is working.' Rows lead with the job — Email sending · File uploads · Spam protection · Web address — service names (Resend, R2, Turnstile) as small print; chips read working / not set up. The mail row names the connected Resend sender and account (derived from real config, never a stored flag — extend GET /api/v1/instance/status if needed) and offers an Open Resend link out. Applies everywhere the panel renders (setup dashboard D8 panel + steady state). Steady-state placement is a tab of the org-settings surface MRQ-207 is building in parallel: if 207 has merged when you integrate, mount there (route org/server, redirect org/instance); otherwise mount behind your own route and say so in the PR. Recovery card copy per prototype ('no passwords, ever').
title: Server panel: plain-language connections, named Resend account
